products.name: HeartGold & SoulSilver Poster Pack [Ho-Oh]
products.note: Two HeartGold & SoulSilver packs, two POP Series 9 packs, a double-sided poster and the Ho-Oh promo (HGSS01); the Lugia version is its own product (Bulbapedia HGSS merchandise, dacardworld and Previews World listings, Pokellector). The poster is not simulated.

products.name: HeartGold & SoulSilver Poster Pack [Lugia]
products.note: Two HeartGold & SoulSilver packs, two POP Series 9 packs, a double-sided poster and the Lugia promo (HGSS02). The poster is not simulated.

products.name: HeartGold & SoulSilver Three Pack Blister [Pikachu]
products.note: Two HeartGold & SoulSilver packs, one Legends Awakened pack, a coin and the Pikachu promo (HGSS03). Collector's Cache and loosepacks agree on the pack mix; the coin is not simulated.

products.name: HeartGold & SoulSilver Three Pack Blister [Wobbuffet]
products.note: Two HeartGold & SoulSilver packs, one Legends Awakened pack, a coin and the Wobbuffet promo (HGSS04). The coin is not simulated.

products.name: HeartGold & SoulSilver Two Pack Blister [Hoothoot and Noctowl]
products.note: One HeartGold & SoulSilver pack, one POP Series 9 pack and the two promos, Hoothoot (HGSS05) and Noctowl (HGSS06). Pack mix from one Bulbapedia excerpt (medium-low).

products.name: Spring 2010 Collector's Tin [Feraligatr Prime]
products.note: Four packs: two HeartGold & SoulSilver, one Legends Awakened, one Platinum (loosepacks Tin Contents Database; Bulbapedia excerpt) and the Feraligatr Prime promo (HGSS07). The tin is not simulated.

products.name: Spring 2010 Collector's Tin [Meganium Prime]
products.note: Four packs: two HeartGold & SoulSilver, one Legends Awakened, one Platinum, and the Meganium Prime promo (HGSS08).

products.name: Spring 2010 Collector's Tin [Typhlosion Prime]
products.note: Four packs: two HeartGold & SoulSilver, one Legends Awakened, one Platinum, and the Typhlosion Prime promo (HGSS09).

products.name: Fall 2010 Legendary Beast Tin [Raikou]
products.note: Four packs of the 2010 print: HeartGold & SoulSilver, Undaunted, Arceus and a Platinum pack (loosepacks; the slot is 'Platinum Base or Stormfront', opened here as Platinum; medium-low) and the Raikou promo (HGSS19). The 2012 reissue held three packs.

products.name: Fall 2010 Legendary Beast Tin [Entei]
products.note: Four packs of the 2010 print: HeartGold & SoulSilver, Undaunted, Arceus and a Platinum pack, and the Entei promo (HGSS20).

products.name: Fall 2010 Legendary Beast Tin [Suicune]
products.note: Four packs of the 2010 print: HeartGold & SoulSilver, Undaunted, Arceus and a Platinum pack, and the Suicune promo (HGSS21).
